sources.title: AutoCause: A Python framework that automates expert decisions in environmental time-series causal discovery
sources.primary_result: An auditable workflow records method, CI test, lag, sample adequacy, FDR, surrogate and support decisions; majority-supported links were more precise on synthetic benchmarks but not against river topology.
sources.project_delta: Add auditable multi-method support as a diagnostic only; never use method voting as causal truth.

sources.title: Conditioning-Depth Diagnostics for Hidden Memory in Temporal Causal Discovery
sources.primary_result: Graph instability across matched conditioning depths can flag hidden memory or state inadequacy but does not identify the mechanism or recover a latent graph.

sources.title: Identifiable Markov Switching Models with Instantaneous Effects and Exponential Families
sources.primary_result: Latent regimes and regime-dependent causal structures are identifiable within a specified Markov-switching SCM class under explicit temporal, functional and noise assumptions.
sources.project_delta: Admit FlowMSM-like regime recovery only with complete identifiability-assumption receipts; otherwise preserve context risk.
